results.snippet: Washington competes in the NCAA Division I Football Bowl Subdivision (FBS) as a member of the Big Ten Conference, having been a charter member of the Pac-12 Conference between 1915 and 2024. The 70,138-capacity Husky Stadium, located on campus in Seattle, has been the Huskies' home field since 1920.
